description: Select a winner for an A/B test. For a campaign A/B test that is currently testing, this queues the winning variant for the remaining audience and starts external email delivery. For a sequence A/B test (nodeType action_ab_test), this selects or changes the winner, including one picked automatically: everyone who reaches the step afterwards gets the new winner, and contacts who already got a variant keep it. Pass confirmLiveChange when the sequence is active.

abTestId.description: Campaign or sequence A/B test ID

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

confirmLiveChange.description: Sequence tests only. Required as true when the sequence is active, because the new winner goes to everyone who reaches the step from then on.

name: select_ab_test_winner

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `select_ab_test_winner` MCP tool.
